status: host-reference-only; runtime and compiler parity not established
chunk_semantics: each chunk is one complete compressed access unit, or a bounded independently replayable encoded segment explicitly admitted by codec provider
counters: u64 on native backends; JS reference admits nonnegative safe integers only; sequence initial 0, last-applied sentinel -1
acknowledgment: cumulative highest contiguous fully applied sequence + matching end byte offset; never treat network receipt alone as applied

resume_modes.continue: no missing chunks and byte offset matches
resume_modes.replay: all missing retained chunks contiguous and decoder configuration matches
resume_modes.reset: missing chunks or config mismatch; restart from retained verified random-access point after decoder reset
resume_modes.fail: KEYFRAME_REQUIRED when no safe retained decoder anchor exists

security_notes: Transport authentication, anti-replay, resource capability and integrity verification are mandatory at host ingress and not implemented by the host state-machine reference.
The randomAccess flag must be derived from trusted codec parsing and a complete independently decodable restart point, never accepted from untrusted transport metadata.
A per-stream payload limit does not bound object headers, crypto engine temporary allocations or whole-process RSS. Admission must include global and per-tenant memory limits.

receiver_semantics.offer: Validate identity, owned payload integrity, next sequence/offset and codec dependency without advancing applied checkpoint.
receiver_semantics.commit: Only after successful decoder/application transaction, advance applied checkpoint and attach explicit gap proof for any skipped sequences. Keep bounded digest ledger for duplicate conflict checks.
receiver_semantics.resetAt: Preserves last-applied watermark until verified first random-access unit is committed. Bind new codecConfigId at reset and reject a different config before mutation.
receiver_semantics.acknowledgment: Receiver's committed checkpoint, never the last network-received chunk, determines sender replay and ACK retention.

sender_recovery_receipt.state: host reference only; trusted adapter must authenticate the request
validation: stream ID and generation equal owner
previous applied sequence and endOffset equal acknowledged watermark
skipped range begins immediately after that watermark and ends before restart
restartSequence points to a retained codec-verified random-access unit
restartOffset and final acknowledged endOffset match actually emitted chunks
sender_recovery_receipt.result: frees explicitly abandoned bytes while retaining a separately visible lastDiscontinuity; never interprets skipped units as successfully decoded
sender_recovery_receipt.codec_transition: A contiguous replay plan must fail closed with CODEC_CONFIG_TRANSITION when retained chunks include differing codec configurations. Caller must negotiate decoder reinit at verified boundary.

execution_evidence: 45 local Node 22.16.0 host reference tests passed, eight additional source-free guest-receipt validator tests authored; no exact-head guest compiler/backend execution established.
